MORE:
This is to inform that pursuant to Regulation 30 and 33 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations 2015, the Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held today i.e. 12th November, 2026 considered and approved the Unaudited Financial Results, along with the 'Limited Review Report' from the Statutory Auditors thereon for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026.  Enclosed herewith is a copy of the same.

The said meeting commenced at 03:00 P.M. and concluded at 04.00 P.M.

MORE:
Jupiter Industries & Leasing Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 12/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve Pursuant to Regulation 29(1) of the SEBI (Listing Obligation & Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, this is to inform that the Meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company will be held on Thursday, 12th November, 2026, at 3.00 p.m. at the Registered Office of the Company at 209, Maker Bhavan III, 21 New Marine Lines, Mumbai - 400 020 to consider the following:
